description_en: Retrieves the configuration information of a specified executor
description_zh: 获取制定执行器配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx3 get-executor-config --cluster-id xxljob-a1804a3226d --app-name test-app --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetExecutorConfig

Config.description_en:
The default global configuration of a data integration Solutions node (the default processing policy configured for different DDL message types). Example:
{"RENAMECOLUMN":"WARNING","DROPTABLE":"WARNING","CREATETABLE":"WARNING","MODIFYCOLUMN":"WARNING","TRUNCATETABLE":"WARNING","DROPCOLUMN":"WARNING","ADDCOLUMN":"WARNING","RENAMETABLE":"WARNING"}

DDL message types:
RENAMECOLUMN: Rename a column.
DROPTABLE: Delete a table.
CREATETABLE: Create a table.
MODIFYCOLUMN: Modify a column type.
TRUNCATETABLE: Truncate a table.
DROPCOLUMN: Delete a column.
ADDCOLUMN: Add a column.
RENAMETABLE: Rename a table.

When DataWorks receives a DDL message of the corresponding type, the processing policy is as follows:
WARNING: The message is discarded. An alerting record is written to the real-time synchronization log, indicating that the message was discarded because an error occurred during execution.
IGNORE: The message is discarded and is not sent to the destination data source.
CRITICAL: The real-time synchronization node enters an error state and stops running.
NORMAL: The message is forwarded to the destination data source for processing. Because different destination data sources may handle DDL messages differently, DataWorks only performs the send operation
Config.description_zh:
数据集成同步解决方案任务默认的全局配置内容（即对不同DDL消息类型配置的默认处理策略）。示例如下：
{"RENAMECOLUMN":"WARNING","DROPTABLE":"WARNING","CREATETABLE":"WARNING","MODIFYCOLUMN":"WARNING","TRUNCATETABLE":"WARNING","DROPCOLUMN":"WARNING","ADDCOLUMN":"WARNING","RENAMETABLE":"WARNING"}

DDL消息类型如下：
RENAMECOLUMN：重命名列。
DROPTABLE：删除表。
CREATETABLE：新建表。
MODIFYCOLUMN：修改列类型。
TRUNCATETABLE：清空表。
DROPCOLUMN：删除列。
ADDCOLUMN：新增列。
RENAMETABLE：重命名表。

DataWorks收到对应类型的DDL消息时，处理策略如下：
WARNING：直接丢弃该消息，同时会在实时同步日志中记录告警信息，指明该消息因执行出错被丢弃。
IGNORE：直接丢弃该消息，不再向目的端数据源发送。
CRITICAL：实时同步任务直接显示出错状态并终止运行。
NORMAL：将相应消息继续下发给目的端数据源，由目的端数据源来处理。因为不同目的端数据源对DDL消息处理策略可能会不同，因此DataWorks只执行转发操作
